Improve this selected implementation design while preserving the user's outcome and constraints. Trace it as a coding agent would. Identify concrete corrections to ownership, interfaces, sequencing, compatibility, error/recovery, observability, or verification. Prefer a smaller coherent correction. Propose another architecture only if evidence shows this one cannot satisfy a hard constraint. Do not implement, use tools, delegate, invoke skills, or edit files. All evidence is in this packet; identify gaps instead of inventing facts. Map every explicit requirement to a plan location and acceptance criterion; flag missing coverage. Then return findings with priority (blocking/improvement), plan location, supporting source evidence or evidence gap, implementing-agent failure mode, and proposed correction. Omit style-only preferences. If no material findings exist, say `No material findings` after the coverage map. Additional verified facts (not in the brief): - `PermissionState` (apps/desktop/src/application/application-controller.ts:41-44): `{kind:'fresh'; listing}` | `{kind:'loading'|'stale'; listing: AvailablePermissions|null; reason}` | `{kind:'unsupported'; reason}`. Initial value (line 148): `{kind:'stale', listing:null, reason:'Open a conversation to read permissions.'}`. - `ProviderObservationStatus` (packages/contracts/src/observation.ts:19-22): `not-applicable|recovering|observing` | `stopped` | `concluded`; controller adds `{kind:'unknown'}`. - `CommandActivity`/`FileActivity` return null when empty. - Tests: journey.browser.test.mjs:238 waits for heading 'Your conversation'; module-actions.browser.test.mjs:27 finds `complementary 'Customization fixture'`, :43/:73 read textbox 'Message' value, :85 reads `.scope-label` textContent; agent-routing.test.mjs:146-147 assert chips ['Codex','Select model','Default'] and the disabled effort button; tests/host/extensions/extension-only.test.mjs:152,159 assert body text lacks /Recorded playback|Recorded host/. - agent-presentation.ts: codex footer 'Local Codex · Approvals required for changes', buildLabel 'Local Codex host'; recorded footer 'Recorded playback · No live model', buildLabel 'Browser development · Recorded host'. - BrowserApplication.tsx keeps `app.active` while `selectedView` is 'extensions'; the chat view is hidden via `hidden` on `.shell-view`, not unmounted. ## Selected design rationale (summary) Base design: "show only what can act" — gate chrome on relevance, move non-empty custom tool modules to the Extensions view, "+" and panel-wide drop for images. Grafted: visually-hidden header (tests/a11y), kind-based permission gate, auto-grow textarea, disclosure moved to shell footer, panel-wide drop target, Extensions tools section names its conversation. Rejected: composer Tools popover (keeps tools on this screen), combined harness/model picker and details drawer (scope), byte sniffing (host is authority), greeting line (calmer without). ## Plan files ### 00-overview.md # Simplify the new-conversation screen Status: Ready (pending refinement pass). Implementation has not started. Base commit: `10a4d08` on `main`. ## Application context The context was confirmed for this repository on 2026-11-18 in `.agents/plans/extensions-nav-crew-coworkers/00-overview.md` and is reused here. OpenPane has one user, on a private overlay network. ```json { "application_context": { "has_active_users": false, "backward_compatibility_required": false, "feature_flags": "not-applicable", "confirmation_digest": "34b9a519ecefc94d75efe4ffa2fc7671cf5c90bb1936dde430a6049a2beb93b4", "confirmed_at": "2026-11-18T04:10:00Z" } } ``` The change is a direct UI cutover. It needs no flag and no compatibility shim. ## Change type and affected areas This is a UI redesign of the desktop conversation panel. It touches these files: - `apps/desktop/src/application/ConversationView.tsx` - `ConversationPermissions.tsx` - `CustomizationModules.tsx` - `CustomizationContent.tsx` - `ComposerAgentControls.tsx` - `ExtensionsView.tsx` - `application.css` - `apps/desktop/src/shell/BrowserApplication.tsx` - `apps/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json` - the browser tests under `tests/application/` ## Requested outcome An empty conversation shows a calm canvas with one composer, and it still looks like OpenPane. Success criteria. Each is observable in the browser build: 1. An empty Codex conversation shows only the composer: the placeholder, "+", the harness chip, the model chip and Send. The page also shows the shell footer. It does not show a visible header, a Permissions card, "Send a message to begin.", "Custom tools", the disabled effort chip or the in-composer disclosure line. 2. Typing in the composer shows only the caret. The computed `box-shadow` of `.composer` is `none` while the textarea has focus. 3. The textarea has no resize grip (`resize: none`). It grows with its content up to a cap, then scrolls. 4. Dropping a PNG or JPEG anywhere on the conversation panel attaches it. Invalid drops explain why and change nothing. 5. Custom tool modules no longer render on the conversation screen. Non-empty modules appear in the Extensions view. Empty module sets render nothing anywhere. 6. The icon rail and the Chats sidebar are unchanged, in both markup and CSS. ## Scope and non-goals In scope: - the conversation panel and its composer; - the components the panel renders; - the effort chip in the empty-workspace screen, which shares `ComposerAgentControls`; - the shell footer's right-hand label while the Chats view is shown. Not in scope: - `.view-rail`, `.application-controls` and the Chats list; - the harness and model picker behaviour; - a new settings page for tools; - native (Tauri) file-path drop handling; - the iOS app; - pairing or attestation (AGENTS.md). ## Findings that drive the design - The two empty "Custom tools" boxes come from the crew and coworkers namespaces. Both contribute `modules: []` (`extensions/crew/src/desktop/index.tsx:11`, `extensions/coworkers/src/desktop/index.tsx:11`). `ConversationModules` renders a fieldset regardless (`CustomizationModules.tsx:70-74`). - The Permissions card renders whenever `permissionState` is set (`ConversationView.tsx:172`). Codex returns `{ kind: 'unsupported' }` (`application-controller.ts:41-44, 272-274`). - The focus ring is `.composer:focus-within` (`application.css:121`). The grip comes from `resize: vertical` (`application.css:119`). - The effort chip is hard-wired disabled (`ComposerAgentControls.tsx:97`). - "Add image" is a text button that opens a hidden input (`ConversationView.tsx:199-210`). - Tauri's native drag-drop handler is on by default, and the window has no `dragDropEnabled` key (`tauri.conf.json:14`). `main.rs:137` builds the window from that config. - Tests depend on hidden header parts: `journey.browser.test.mjs:238` waits for the heading "Your conversation", and `module-actions.browser.test.mjs:85` reads `.scope-label`. The effort chip is asserted at `agent-routing.test.mjs:146-147`. ## Selected design: "Show only what can act" The design began as proposal C (Grok). It adds grafts from A (Opus) and B (Sol). See [research/decision.md](research/decision.md) for the three proposals, the scores and the reasons for each choice. ```text Before (empty Codex chat) After ┌───────────────────────────────┐ ┌───────────────────────────────┐ │ Your conversation │ │ │ │ GPT-6.2 Sol │ │ │ │───────────────────────────────│ │ │ │ ┌ Permissions ──────────────┐ │ │ ╭─────────────────────────╮ │ │ │ does not report… [Refresh]│ │ │ │ Write to Codex…▍ │ │ │ └───────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ │ │ Send a message to begin. │ │ │ + Codex ⌄ GPT-6.2 ⌄ ↑ │ │ │ ┌ Custom tools ─────────────┐ │ │ ╰─────────────────────────╯ │ │ └───────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ ┌ Custom tools ─────────────┐ │ │ │ │ └───────────────────────────┘ │ │ │ │ ╔═══════════════════════════╗ │ ring │ │ │ ║ Write to Codex… ⟋ ║ │ grip │ │ │ ║ [Add image] ║ │ │ │ │ ║ Codex⌄ GPT⌄ Default⌄ Send ║ │ │ │ │ ║ Local Codex · Approvals… ║ │ │ │ │ ╚═══════════════════════════╝ │ │ │ │ ● Conversation connected Local Codex host │ ● Conversation connected Local Codex · Approvals required for changes │ └───────────────────────────────┘ └───────────────────────────────┘ ``` Once the conversation has content, the transcript scrolls and the same composer sits at the bottom. A pending image is a compact chip inside the composer. The table shows where each removed element goes: | Element | Destination | |---|---| | Header (h1, agent label, scope) | Kept in the DOM but visually hidden. The model chip already shows the agent. | | Permissions card | Rendered only when the provider supports permissions. Its region, labels and buttons are unchanged ([02](02-permissions-and-tools.md)). | | "Send a message to begin." | Removed. The placeholder invites input. | | Custom tools | Empty sets render nothing. Non-empty sets move to the Extensions view. Load and failure notices stay in the column ([02](02-permissions-and-tools.md)). | | Add image | Replaced by a "+" icon button and drag and drop on the panel ([03](03-image-drop.md)). | | Effort chip | Removed. | | Composer disclosure | Moved to the shell footer's right side on the Chats view. | | Ring and grip | Removed. The textarea auto-grows ([01](01-composer-chrome.md)). | ## Review coverage | Stage | Result | |---|---| | Proposals | All three seats completed (`research/proposals/pass-1`). | | Refinement | Recorded in `research/refinement/`. The reviewed packet's SHA-256 is recorded there. | ## Risks and assumptions - **Assumption:** with `dragDropEnabled: false`, the macOS WKWebView delivers HTML5 `File` objects. If not, the "+" picker still works. The fallback is a native-path drop, which is a separate change. Gate: a manual Finder-to-composer drop in `npm run desktop:dev` ([04](04-execution-handoff.md) WP4). - **Assumption:** nothing in the app listens for `tauri://drag-drop`. Gate: `grep -rn "drag-drop\|onDragDropEvent" apps/desktop` returns nothing. - **Tradeoff (non-blocking):** module actions in Extensions run against the active conversation while it is off screen. The section names that conversation. - **Product choice (non-blocking):** the empty canvas has no greeting line. Proposal A's greeting ("A conversation that stays with you.") can be added later as a single element. ## Document map | File | Purpose | |---|---| | [01-composer-chrome.md](01-composer-chrome.md) | Ring, grip, auto-grow, hidden header, empty-state centring, effort chip, footer disclosure. | | [02-permissions-and-tools.md](02-permissions-and-tools.md) | The permissions gate, and moving custom tools to the Extensions view. | | [03-image-drop.md](03-image-drop.md) | The "+" button, drag and drop on the panel, validation, and the Tauri setting. | | [04-execution-handoff.md](04-execution-handoff.md) | Ordered work packages, commands, and the definition of done. | | [research/](research/) | The brief, the decision record, the three proposals and the refinement record. | ### 01-composer-chrome.md # 01 — Composer and panel chrome ## Goal The conversation panel shows a transcript and one quiet composer. The selected design can meet the outcome. It needs closed decisions at seven places where an implementing agent would otherwise guess, unmount the wrong thing, or satisfy a test by putting chrome back. No new architecture is required.

## Coverage map

| Requirement | Plan location | Acceptance | Coverage |
|---|---|---|---|
| Calm empty Codex canvas: placeholder, "+", harness chip, model chip, Send, shell footer | `00` success 1; `01` goal and ASCII | `01` items 1, 2, 7, 8 | Partial. Predicate ignores the conflict alert and `CommandRecovery`. Empty ready namespaces still mount `<aside>`s. |
| No visible header, empty-state line, Permissions card, "Custom tools", effort chip, or in-composer disclosure | `00` table; `01` changes 1–2, 4; `02` gate; effort deletion | `01` item 2; `02` items 1 and 3 | Permissions negative case has no test command. Recorded string "Send a message to begin this recorded demonstration." is the same paragraph but is absent from `01` item 2. |
| Heading "Your conversation" and `.scope-label` stay in the DOM | `01` header | `01` item 3 | The visibility-wait edit is conditional, so the header can be made visible again to go green. |
| Typing shows only the caret; `.composer` `box-shadow` is `none` | `01` CSS lines 6 and 121 | `01` item 4 | Covered for the focused textarea. |
| `resize: none`; grows to a cap, then scrolls | `01` textarea and CSS line 119 | `01` item 5 | Criterion cannot be met as written: ten lines do not reach `40vh` on a normal window. |
| After the first message, composer sits at the bottom | `01` `data-empty` | `01` item 8 | Covered if `data-empty` is removed. |
| Send still submits | `01` Send button | `01` item 6 | Covered. `aria-label="Send"` keeps the accessible name. |
| Drop a PNG or JPEG anywhere on the panel attaches it | `03` drop zone and `tauri.conf.json` | `03` items 1 and 2 | Browser cases are specified. Finder success can be rejected before the extension fallback. Sidebar navigation has the wrong follow-up. |
| Invalid drops explain why and change nothing | `03` `dragVerdict`, `intakeFile`, drop states | `03` item 1, six cases | Size string is specified. Count and type strings for `intakeFile` are not. `imageError`’s `{store, message}` shape is not. |
| "+" is the keyboard path; Enter opens the chooser | `03` "+" button | `03` item 3 | Markup block has no `onClick`. Input value reset is not preserved. |
| Existing picker, chip, Retry, Remove, "Image file" stay | `03` tests that should pass unchanged | `03` item 1 | `Remove`’s accessible name is "confirm", not a fixed requirement. |
| Custom tools leave the default conversation screen; non-empty modules appear in Extensions | `02` routing; `00` success 5 | `02` items 3 and 4 | `00` success 5 forbids every conversation-screen module, which contradicts `02` item 6. |
| Empty module sets render nothing anywhere | `02` `ConversationModules` returns null | `02` item 3 | Only the "Custom tools" legend is checked. The empty `<aside>` remains. |
| Claimed layouts still receive modules | `02` `moduleAll` | `02` item 6 | Contradicts `00` success 5. No carve-out in the overview. |
| Load-failure alert stays in the conversation column | `02` `surface="status"` | `02` item 5 | Cited tests (`frontend-tools`, `journey`, `transcript-overrides`). Alert is inside the chats shell-view, which is `hidden` on Extensions. |
| Extensions tools name the active conversation | `02` `ExtensionsList` | `02` item 4 ("Runs in …") | Label source is "the catalog", which is not in the packet. `hasTools` can render the section with `tools={null}`. |
| Module actions from Extensions update the conversation | `02` test steps | `02` item 4 | Steps match the cited `module-actions` lines, including returning to Chats before the Message assertion. |
| Permissions only when the provider can show a listing; Crew revoke and Refresh stay | `02` table and `permissionsShown` | `02` items 1 and 2 | Gate is unresolved ("Refinement decides"). Unmount drops the focus listener. WP2 runs only the Crew test. |
| Disclosure moves to the shell footer on Chats | `01` `buildLabel` | `01` item 7 | Workspace uses the same composer and loses the line. `extension-only.test.mjs` is "confirm when it runs" and is not in the WP1 command. |
| Effort chip removed, including the empty workspace | `01` `ComposerAgentControls` | `01` item 2; `agent-routing.test.mjs:146-147` | Covered. |
| Rail and Chats sidebar markup and CSS unchanged | `00` success 6; `01` exclusions; `04` | `04` CSS diff check | Covered if shared selectors that also mention `.application-controls` are left intact. |
| No greeting, no picker redesign, no byte sniffing, no native-path drop, no paste, no iOS | `00` non-goals; `01` and `03` exclusions; `04` deferred | None, correctly | Host remains the content authority (`intakeFile` checks MIME and extension only). |
| `dragDropEnabled: false` only if nothing listens for `tauri://drag-drop` | `00` risks; `03`; `04` WP4 pre-check | Pre-check prints nothing | No stop rule if the grep prints a hit. |
| Full gate | `04` integration | `npm run verify`, screenshots, manual Finder drop | "Compare against the screenshots in the request" points at the before picture. |

## Findings

### 1. Blocking — Permissions gate unmounts the only focus refresh

**Plan location:** `02` Permissions, the `permissionsShown` note that says "Refinement decides."

**Evidence:** `PermissionState` is `fresh` with a listing, `loading` or `stale` with `listing | null` and a `reason`, or `unsupported` with a `reason`. The initial value is `{kind:'stale', listing:null, reason:'Open a conversation to read permissions.'}`. `ConversationPermissions.tsx:15-19` registers the window `focus` reader only while the component is mounted, and it does not read on mount. The revoke failure string "Revocation failed. Refresh permissions." is local state at line 24, not a `PermissionState` reason. Controller transitions after a failed read are not in the packet.

**Failure mode:** `{permissionsShown && <ConversationPermissions/>}` unmounts the listener for every `stale` or `loading` state with a null listing, which is the state a new conversation starts in. A later `stale` null listing with a real reason also has no Refresh control. The agent string-matches "Revocation failed…", which never appears on `PermissionState`, or shows the placeholder card again so the Crew test can find `region "Permissions"`.

**Correction:** Close the predicate.
